description: This file defines an internal, immutable class 'DittoDuration' that models durations with positive amounts, supports conversion from Java Duration and parsing from string, and distinguishes durations based on time units such as milliseconds, seconds, and minutes. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing, and converting durations.

classes.name: DittoDuration
classes.description: Immutable class representing a positive duration with parsing and conversion capabilities.

classes.name: DittoDuration.DittoTimeUnit
classes.description: Enumeration representing supported time units (seconds, milliseconds, minutes) with associated suffixes and conversion to Java Duration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a positive Java Duration.

methods.name: parseDuration
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence into a DittoDuration, supporting suffixes ms, s, m, or plain numbers as seconds.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the duration is zero.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration as a Java Duration object.
